description: This file is a Perl script for processing kernel configuration files, providing functions for loading, comparing, modifying, and printing configuration data used typically in Linux kernel or embedded system configurations.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets or updates a configuration value based on certain conditions.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Reads a configuration file and loads its entries into a hash reference.

methods.name: config_and
methods.description: Creates a configuration hash that is the intersection of two configs where values match.

methods.name: config_add
methods.description: Merges two configuration hashes, optionally handling 'plus' modifications.

methods.name: config_diff
methods.description: Generates a configuration hash representing differences between two configs.

methods.name: config_sub
methods.description: Subtracts the entries of one configuration hash from another.

methods.name: print_cfgline
methods.description: Prints a configuration entry in a standardized format.

methods.name: dump_config
methods.description: Outputs the entire configuration hash in a readable format.

methods.name: parse_expr
methods.description: Parses configuration expressions with recursive logic for various operators.
